title: [CQ-R09c] Copy-only snapshot materialization in the guest
description:
Objective: copy one exported source snapshot (protected base plus overlay) into an owned guest's workspace over the protected supervisor's stdin, never a mount. Prove that the guest received exactly those bytes, and that no host filesystem is mounted in the guest before or after the copy.

Context: third slice of CQ-R09 (task-0dd1cce23a6646fd80cf401dd47c7b0f), split 3 ways on 2026-10-27 with the operator's approval in the architect REPL. It builds on the landed CQ-R08 bridge chain and CQ-R10a's teardown in guest-supervisor.py (both DONE). It consumes the SourceSnapshot shape that CQ-R09b (task-697fb2de19324ccb851defaf9f24043b) produces, but its tests build snapshots with validateImport directly, so it runs in parallel with R09b; CQ-R09 final's end-to-end test joins the two. CQ-R09 final adds the export direction on top of this module and mode, CQ-R10 binds attempts to the workspace defined here, and CQ-R11 extends materialization to check environments.

Deliverable:
1. New scripts/local-runner/snapshot-transfer.mjs exporting:
- SNAPSHOT_CHUNK_BYTES = 1048576, the raw bytes per host data frame.
- workspaceEntries(snapshot): checks the SourceSnapshot shape (version 1, sealed base and overlay), then returns validateImport of the merged view: base files, replaced or added by overlay files, minus overlay deletes. Its digest is the materialization identity.
- snapshotArgv(name, mode): frozen ['exec', '--no-map-working-directory', name, '--', 'sudo', '-n', GUEST_LAYOUT.supervisor, mode], for an owned instance name and mode 'materialize' or 'export' only.
- assertNoMounts(name, provider): readGuestInfo must report zero Multipass mounts and the R07 mountinfo probe must show no host-sharing filesystem, reusing guest-readiness.mjs's mount rule (export mountFailure unchanged). Otherwise it throws TRANSFER_MOUNTS_PRESENT or TRANSFER_MOUNTS_UNKNOWN; provider failures keep their fixed PROVIDER_* codes.
- runSupervisorStream({ name, mode, provider, timeoutMs, input, onFrame }): spawns snapshotArgv(name, mode) through provider.spawn (default child_process.spawn) with shell:false. It writes the input frame Buffers to stdin with backpressure, then ends stdin; decodes stdout with createFrameDecoder(MAX_GUEST_FRAME_BYTES), calling onFrame with each decoded object; and resolves only after stdout EOF and provider exit 0 within timeoutMs. Any other outcome kills the provider and rejects with a fixed TRANSFER_* code (spawn, timeout, exit or frame), never guest text. An error thrown by onFrame kills the provider and rejects with that same error.
- materializeSnapshot({ name, snapshot, provider = {}, timeoutMs }): assertNoMounts; stream the frames below; require exactly one {kind:'materialized', digest} whose digest equals workspaceEntries(snapshot).digest; assertNoMounts again; then resolve frozen { instance, digest, files, bytes, executionReady: false }.
Host frames, each within MAX_HOST_FRAME_BYTES: {kind:'snapshot', version: 1, files, bytes, digest}; then, per file in manifest order, {kind:'file', path, executable, size} followed by ceil(size / SNAPSHOT_CHUNK_BYTES) {kind:'data', data} frames of base64; then {kind:'end'}.

2. guest-supervisor.py materialize mode. main(['materialize']) runs only as euid 0 (else 77); any other argv stays 64. materialize(in_fd, out_fd, workspace=WORKSPACE, manifest=WORKSPACE_MANIFEST, owner=None):
- WORKSPACE = '/var/lib/moe/workspace' and WORKSPACE_MANIFEST = '/var/lib/moe/workspace.manifest.json'. An existing workspace or manifest exits EX_CANTCREAT (73).
- It builds the tree in a root-only (0700) staging directory beside WORKSPACE, with directory-fd-relative O_NOFOLLOW and O_EXCL creates. No symlink is ever followed, and a traversal, absolute, empty-segment, NUL or duplicate path is refused even from the host.
- It checks every size and the header counts, and recomputes R09a's digest framing from the bytes it wrote.
- On a match it gives the tree to the AGENT_IDENTITY account (root directory 0700) and renames it into place. It then writes WORKSPACE_MANIFEST (root, 0600, O_EXCL; UTF-8 JSON {"version": 1, "digest": hex, "files": {path: [executable, size, sha256 hex]}}), which CQ-R09's export mode diffs against, writes exactly one {kind:'materialized', digest} frame and exits 0.
- A malformed or out-of-order frame, a bound breach or a mismatch exits EX_DATAERR (65); an I/O failure exits EX_IOERR (74). Both remove the staging tree and write no frame.

3. Tests in scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs. Host rows reuse its fakeGuest mount fixtures and a fake spawn. Supervisor rows load the real guest-supervisor.py under python3 -I -B with injected workspace, manifest and owner (the R08b test-seam pattern). One end-to-end row materializes through the real supervisor. Rows that need POSIX python skip on win32 with a reason.

Not in scope: the export/import direction and its supervisor mode (CQ-R09 final); per-attempt workspaces, job identities or credentials (CQ-R10); check environments (CQ-R11); host admission (CQ-R12); real VM certification (CQ-R13); `multipass mount` or `multipass transfer`. executionReady stays false and verified-local stays unavailable.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs
definitionOfDone: The snapshot reaches the guest only through snapshotArgv(name, 'materialize') on the supervisor's stdin, spawned with shell:false. No mount or transfer subcommand, host path or snapshot byte appears in any provider argv (tests record every provider call).
materializeSnapshot refuses unless readGuestInfo shows zero mounts and mountinfo shows no host-sharing filesystem, both before and after the copy, and it never spawns when the first check fails.

Identities come from the transferred bytes: the supervisor recomputes R09a's digest from the bytes it wrote, and the host accepts only one materialized frame whose digest equals workspaceEntries(snapshot).digest. A wrong, missing or repeated frame, or a nonzero exit, is a fixed refusal.

The materialize mode refuses traversal, absolute, empty-segment and duplicate paths, symlink-redirected writes, and an existing workspace or manifest. After any failure it handles, it leaves neither a staging tree nor a partial workspace (supervisor rows under python3).
The listed verification command exits 0 and its fresh output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
